localChanges: Computer players' Settlers, and your Automated Settlers, now build Roads, and later Railroads, along the way between neighbouring cities (closes #384).
Once you know Railroad, they also build a Road where only the Railroad on it would pay, such as on a River (closes #385).
They clean up pollution, and computer players whose leaders mind it more get to it sooner (closes #366).
Computer players keep one Settlers improving the land for every six cities, up from one for every eight (closes #234).
